items.text: Nico Collins injured hamstring at Wednesday practice; doctors don't believe serious but Week 2 status vs Bengals in jeopardy. Limited on report; history of missing 5 games in 2024 with hammy.
items.why: Hamstring injury in practice, met doctors, not serious per source but availability jeopardy.
items.implication: High-end WR2 at risk; plan alternatives if OUT. MRI pending.
items.opportunity: Routes 37/42 last week; Boutte/Hutchinson next up if out.

items.text: Alvin Kamara full participant Wednesday, HC Moore feels good/expects play Week 2 vs Ravens after missing W1 (knee/MCL). Reverses prior Miller/Etienne split upside.
items.why: Full practice, coach comments on time-on-task complete.
items.implication: Kamara reclaims role; Etienne/Miller shares drop.

items.text: No Zay Flowers again at Thursday's practice.
items.implication: Status for Week 2 uncertain; monitor Friday report.

items.text: Kenneth Walker saw 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in Chiefs debut. #1 RB overall in range of outcomes if healthy; full-grown-man love.
items.why: Elite target share + rushing role in new offense.
items.implication: Start with confidence; massive season upside.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Likely active, boosts NE backfield options.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to hamstring injury.
items.implication: Monitor for Week 2 availability; handcuff or committee impact.

items.text: Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, did not practice Wednesday but got mental reps and expects to play Sunday vs Texans.
items.why: Back tightness, DNP but self-reported expects play.
items.implication: Likely active; CIN offense on track.

items.text: Deebo Samuel top waiver wire target this week amid 49ers WR injuries (Stribling IR).

Week 2 injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey absence elevates Tre Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane IR to Bateman; AJ Brown to Doubs/Douglas; Stribling IR to Deebo/Robinson; Kamara return reduces Miller; Darnold out to Lock.
items.why: Precise injury fallout mapping for adds.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty Utilization Score 99 in first game under Kubiak (only Bijan higher). Overreaction to injury scare; strong role confirmation.
items.implication: Lock-in RB starter; buy if low.

items.text: Bucky Irving career-high 26% target share, 8 more routes than Gainwell, both RB red-zone touches in first shared backfield game.
items.why: Clear lead in routes/targets/RZ vs Gainwell.

items.text: Colston Loveland 89% route participation (highest TE W1); only 2 targets/0 pts but missed endzone looks. Buy-low if panicked sellers.
items.why: Elite route rate in high-scoring offense despite volume miss.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold (glute) for Sunday vs Cardinals; no plans for IR.
items.implication: Backup (Lock) starts; SEA pass game downgrade short-term.
